key_insight: DreamVideo-Omni introduces a unified diffusion-based framework that decouples and jointly controls multi-subject identity and multi-granularity motion by using Latent Identity Reinforcement Learning, enabling precise identity preservation and flexible motion editing in synthetic videos.
problem_solved: Bridges the gap between identity fidelity and fine-grained motion control in multi-subject video customization, addressing identity degradation, control ambiguity, and limited motion granularity in prior diffusion-based video methods.
method: Decouple identity and motion in a shared latent space within a diffusion backbone to allow independent manipulation of subject identity and motion trajectories.
Latent Identity Reinforcement Learning: a reinforcement objective applied in latent space to enforce consistent, multi-subject identity preservation across frames and longer sequences.

Omni-motion conditioning: multi-granularity motion controls (global pose, local gestures, object interactions) and cross-subject coordination modules to support fine-to-coarse editing and simultaneous multi-subject customization.
impact: Enables practitioners to generate controllable, identity-faithful multi-subject videos for applications such as VFX, virtual production, AR/VR avatars, and data augmentation, reducing manual rework and improving downstream model robustness.
